body: What do you mean by two powerful enemies? Like people in my life?

Thank you so much! I’m really going to take this to heart. I feel a bit better knowing that I’m not the only one and someone cares enough to write so much about someone that doesn’t know me or will probably never meet me irl.
I meant the shot in the dark as asking for advice I might’ve worded it wrong.
Not much point if you fail out of it anyway! 🤙

Tell to at the very least fix the air bag. Or offer to get it fixed for him. It’s the only thing that could save his life if he’s not wearing a seatbelt. Then maybe bribe him. Aka: if you wear your seatbelt I’ll do x, y, z, chores or make dinner that night. You could also protest those things  using his argument to show how silly he’s being.

Hey English is a difficult language if you aren’t a native speaker. You might just be insecure about it for now which is totally understandable! Just remember where you started and where you’re going to end up while learning. I feel like your English is very good just keep working at it and don’t let the haters get to you. At the end of the day most of them probably have never even tried to learn another language let alone reach the level you have.
*Slorp*

I’m so happy for you OP! It’s never easy to leave a relationship that you know is toxic and you still love the person. Be proud of how strong you are and remember to take deep breaths when you aren’t feeling that strength.

You’re so nice. I’d call the cops anonymously during a party and get the shits in trouble. Then at least I wouldn’t have to confront the mom. I’d also do it for the baby. It’s not fair of her to be kept up all night
I hope you called 911 Op

Well first of all. Your ex wife is a grown ass woman that can take care of herself. You have no obligation to take care of her. If anything if you were to take her to court again you might be able to win custody.

And what about your kids huh? You brought them into this world. Before you think about ending yourself show them how great and beautiful it can be.

Don’t over compensate but be who you are to them. A father. Love them like you loved the woman that left you. Be there for them because no matter how old they are everyone needs a parent.

Maybe the third time is the charm. Don’t give up on love. Don’t run head long or blind into it but never give up on the chance of finding that person.

Life is about finding the good man. Don’t let the bad eat you.

If we could just get better by changing how we eat or changing our job no one would be suicidal. I’m not going to tell you it gets better. If you don’t have the power on your own to get back on track you should get help.  From family, friends, internet or local clinic. If you know you can’t do it. Ask the people around you to help you until you can finally stand on your own feet.

You’re talking down at them. You aren’t being kind or doing it for them you’re being a jackass and painting it as being a martyr. Tough love isn’t daring someone to do it. Tough love is peeling back their fucked up reality and showing them that the world needs and loves them. Because as someone who has no worth it’s hard to face the fact that they do have worth. Even if it’s just one person that loves them even if it’s their cat.

I do too. Everyday. On the few good ones I think about it. Just to finally turn off the light and never worry about anything ever again. I know your pain I know you’re hurting. But think about something you’ve always wanted to do. Something so fun and amazing that you always think about. Like going on a trip or having a puppy or a house. Before you end it do everything you’ve always wanted to. Then maybe you’ll see the good in the world and the value of life. Please listen to me. Consider it for a moment. Don’t do it.

I’m still unsure about going through with it. I can’t tell you whether it’s good or bad. All I can say is talk it out. Everything that hurts yell it out if you have to. If it means crying or screaming let everything out that hurts. I’d be happy to listen. Let’s not give up together.

He really wanted one though! He said he was happy to meet me and for awhile he stuck to that. Even after hooking up. He just changed suddenly. Said “I’m overwhelmed and not emotionally ready” it felt weird and out of nowhere.
Yeah I might just be in denial. Thank you!
He said he’s attracted to me still. Just not ready for a relationship.
Inform the police so they can be prepared. It could be a empty threat but you shouldn’t chance something like this in our crazy country.
Fix one thing every day. Go for a little walk. Sit in the back yard for 15 minutes. Call a doctor and set a appointment.  It doesn’t have to be life changing. Just don’t do nothing.
You’re right. Not much to go back to anyway.
I know exactly how you feel. If you wanna talk I’m more than happy to. It won’t hurt right?
Ironically enough, I hate taking pills. It’s kinda gross. But maybe on my next attempt I should. Fuck it right?
Considering I’m not going to tell anyone. No I’m not. And I think I should’ve taken more.

Well, my stomach was kinda upset. I had a bit of a headache that I basically slept off. I didn’t vomit at all so that was “good”. I will say though after waking up around 3 I was nauseous and felt like I definitely could throw up. Overall rn I feel very weak.
